steps.title: Fresh-eyes art pass: strategic and close views of every era vs the reference frames; fix the biggest model weaknesses
steps.instructions:
1. Shoot the current game like a player sees it: strategic view and close-ups at DL1, DL3, DL5, DL7 (with AI at matching DL), a battle, a coastal area with ports/ships, forests and mountains, cities of several sizes, armies (infantry, cavalry, artillery, tanks/mechs by era), deposits/mines/farms/homesteads, the marauder camp, oil rigs and factories, aviation over armies. Put each next to the matching reference frame (ref1 medieval strategic, ref3 medieval mid, ref4 medieval close, ref2 future strategic, ref5 future close).
2. As an art director judge honestly what still looks raw, crude, placeholder or off-style compared with the references and the soft spec: e.g. mountains (the rework was dropped earlier), forest density/variety, the marauder camp and army tents, oil rigs/factories of chapters III–IV, aviation (fighter, gunship) over armies, ships, bridges, unit silhouettes at map zoom, building variety in cities, anything that breaks the soft cartoon language. Write the list ranked by visual impact on the strategic view (what a player sees most).
3. Fix the top 4–6 items in Blender (new or reworked models, soft materials and baked AO per §6.5, correct scale and seating), re-export only the touched models, import under the lock, and verify in the game at the same views (before/after pairs). Keep triangle counts and draw calls within budget (instancing where the game already instances).
4. Report the ranked list, what you fixed, before/after sheet paths, perf numbers, and follow-ups that need map_view.gd changes (exact patch).
steps.verify: Before/after sheets next to the reference frames for every fixed item at strategic and close zoom; tools/look_metrics.py on the standard set (no regressions vs the current numbers); perf lines; test_flow.
